architecture.principle: External data providers are isolated behind source adapters. The M12 inference engine consumes only the standardized M12 input contract.

status_definitions.PRIMARY: Preferred official or authoritative source identified for the required variable.
status_definitions.SECONDARY: Authoritative alternative source available if the primary source is unavailable or unsuitable.
status_definitions.PENDING_VERIFICATION: Potential source identified but endpoint, coverage, station mapping, cadence, or semantics still require technical verification.
status_definitions.FALLBACK_PAID: Temporary paid source permitted only if the required operational variable cannot be obtained adequately from official/free sources.
status_definitions.NOT_REQUIRED: Variable is supplied by frozen/static M11 representation and does not require a live external source.

rainfall.organization: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India
rainfall.expected_role: Provide district rainfall observations for M12 operational input.
rainfall.credentials_required: Not assumed; verify at implementation time
rainfall.historical_replay_support: Must be verified separately; operational API availability does not imply complete historical archive access.

soil_moisture.organization: Space Applications Centre, Indian Space Research Organisation
soil_moisture.source_description: MOSDAC provides SMAP L-band derived soil-moisture/soil-wetness products over the Indian region.
soil_moisture.update_characteristic: Official product documentation specifies a 3-day composite.
soil_moisture.spatial_characteristic: Official product documentation specifies approximately 40 km resolution resampled at 0.125 degrees.
soil_moisture.locked_operational_rule: Latest causal observation on or before target date, maximum age 7 days.
soil_moisture.credentials_required: Access mechanism must be verified during implementation.

river_water_level.organization: Central Water Commission, Government of India
river_water_level.documented_capability: CWC operates hydrological observation and flood forecasting stations that measure river gauge/water level and related hydrological variables.
river_water_level.real_time_capability: CWC documentation describes real-time hydrological monitoring and near-real-time flood information.
river_water_level.credentials_required: Must be determined after endpoint/access audit.
river_water_level.historical_replay_support: Must be verified against the exact 14 M11 stations.
river_water_level.paid_fallback_rule: A paid one-month provider may be considered only if an authoritative/free source cannot supply the required 14-channel operational observations with defensible station mapping and temporal coverage.

terrain.operational_rule: Use the exact target-independent district-level terrain representation frozen in M11.

labels.operational_rule: Labels are never fetched or supplied as model inputs during inference. They may only be used after inference for historical demonstration or post-hoc evaluation.
